title: Ritual and order
subtitle: Classics, ritual and institutional identity
shortSummary: Li can refer to texts and norms as well as concrete ritual, relational identity and order within state education.
curatorialDescription: A passage from the Analects provides a textual entry point, while Tang classical learning shows how interpretation entered education and state order.
The concept does not reduce Confucianism to one political ideology; it keeps tensions among text, ritual and institution visible.
researchNote: Different editions of the Corrected Meanings, classical-learning institutions and specific ritual contexts still need item-level citations.
